description: Bornes de recharges - Allier - 2016 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat Départemental d'Energie de l'Allier (SDE 03). Bornes de recharges électriques du département de l'Allier. Le type de borne (« Accélérée » pour une charge à 22kW maxi et « Rapide » pour une charge à 50 kW maxi). Coverage: Syndicat Départemental d'Energie de l'Allier (SDE 03). The publisher named on the listing is Syndicat Départemental d'Energie de l'Allier (SDE 03). Its keywords include recharge, open-data, allier, bornes, donnees-ouvertes, bornes-electriques. The listing shows 5 download or service links in OGC:WFS, OGC:WMS, 0-HTTP--LINK. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
